warning_text:
GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORDING TO THE  SUR-
GEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC
BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK
 OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF  ALCOHOLIC BEV-
ERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OP-
ERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: Brand is mixed case with an ampersand, 'Black & White', followed by a trademark symbol.
Alcohol and net contents sit at the foot of the front in lower case: '40% alc./vol.' and '700 mL'.
The warning's line breaks split three words with hyphens, 'SUR-GEON', 'BEV-ERAGES' and 'OP-ERATE', so the transcription keeps the printed line breaks.
Wider gaps appear inside 'TO THE  SUR-' and 'CONSUMPTION OF  ALCOHOLIC', and the fourth line begins with a leading space; all three are kept in the transcription.
The back's Serving Facts panel separately states 'Alcohol by volume: 40% (80 proof)'; the front's declaration is the one transcribed above.
